title: ירושלים, עיר דוד - 1979 (Jerusalem, City of David - 1979)
author: Y. Shiloh (expedition director)
location_note: City of David; no map reference.
notes: Areas A, D, E, G, H and Warren's Shaft. Natural bedrock pits with EB pottery not coded (natural). Area H installations dated by associated 1st-c. CE finds (coins of the procurators and of the Revolt).

features.subtype: rock-cut channel II (Siloam channel) and channel IV (Area A); built rain-water drainage channel through the city wall (Area E)
features.period: Iron Age II (channels with the 8th-7th c. BCE quarter)
features.quote: קטע מתעלה II - נקבת השילוח - שנבדקה בשנת 1924

features.subtype: Warren's Shaft underground water system (diagonal tunnel and shaft)
features.quote: לקבוצת מפעלי המים קרקעיים-התת מתקופת הברזל 'הב

features.subtype: stepped alley with a drain covered by stone slabs
features.period: finds associated with it of the 1st c. CE; destroyed 70 CE
features.quote: סמטה מדורגת ובה תעלת ניקוז מקורה בלוחות

features.subtype: water cistern among installations of buildings destroyed in 70 CE
features.period: finds associated with it of the 1st c. CE
features.quote: הממצא הקשור בהם היה מן המאה 'הא לסה״נ

title: ירושלים, עיר דוד - 1980 (Jerusalem, City of David - 1980)
author: Y. Shiloh (expedition director)
location_note: City of David; no map reference.
notes: Areas D, E1-E3, G and J (Warren's Shaft). Stepped stone structure, Iron II houses, retaining walls (not eligible). Natural rock pits not coded.

features.subtype: Warren's Shaft system cleared: horizontal and diagonal tunnels, vaulted chamber at the head of the diagonal tunnel
features.period: Iron Age system; vaulted chamber not earlier than the Early Roman period; possibly also used in Second Temple times (hedged)
features.quote: שהחדר המקומר לא יכול היה להיבנות לפני התקדפה הרומית .הקדומה

title: ירושלים, גילה (Jerusalem, Giloh)
author: A. Mazar
notes: Iron Age I settlement: houses, enclosure and city walls, courtyards; no feature of the eligible classes.
